caption:
Spot the error in 5 seconds ⏱

"Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the surprise test on Monday."

Which part is wrong? Watch till the end for the rule 👀

#VerbalAbility #IPMAT #SpotTheError #IPMCareers #EnglishGrammar
answer: B: "was" should be "were" (with neither... nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "students")
